form:FormGroup.label: Enable Archiving
form:FormGroup.helpText: Choose if data should be moved to archive shards after a period of time.

form:FormGroup.label: Frequency
form:FormGroup.helpText: How often to look for data old enough to archive. This is the schedule, not the policy: the minimum archive age above decides which data moves, this decides how often we check. Data can stay in the main store for up to the minimum archive age plus this interval. Checking more often than the bucket granularity gains nothing.

form:FormGroup.label: Archive Data Older Than
form:FormGroup.helpText: Data older than this period becomes eligible for archiving. Must be less than the retention duration.

form:FormGroup.label: Bucket Granularity
form:FormGroup.helpText: How archive shards are time-bucketed: Hour, Day, or Week.

form:FormGroup.label: Keep Trace Root For
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long a trace's root is kept in the live store after the root finished, once its spans have been archived. In effect this is the late-span tolerance: a span arriving within this period still joins its trace, while one arriving later becomes an orphan. Nothing is moved when it expires - the archive already holds the trace, so the root is simply removed. Must be at least one minute and shorter than the retention duration.
